name: Sourdough Baguette
summary: Thin crust, open irregular crumb, aggressive scoring.

steps.text: Autolyse one hour, then add levain and salt.
Bulk three hours with folds every 45 minutes.
Divide, pre-shape, rest 30 minutes, shape long.
Proof in couche, score five overlapping slashes.

bake.notes: Maximum steam for the first 12 minutes, then vent completely.

notes: Scoring at a shallow angle is what opens the ears.
